description.text: MainCourses TheoreticalMechanics，Mechanicsof Materials，Structural Mechanics，Civil Engineering DrawingandCAD，CivilEngineeringMaterials，Concrete Structure Design Basic Principle，DesignPrinciplesofSteelStructure，CivilEngineeringConstruction，SoilMechanics&Substructure，CivilEngineeringSurveying，Earthquake Resistanceof Engineering Structure，Building Construction,Bridge Construction. Study Duration 3 years Degree Awarded Students who are eligible to obtain a doctoral degree and graduate diploma must successfully complete the prescribed credits delivered by Major Cultivation Program and pass the graduate dissertation.

duration.text: The Civil Engineering at Shenyang University of Technology is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3333 USD/per year ￥ 24000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 2. Master's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 3. Transcript of postgraduate school 4. Photocopy of 1st page to 8th page of your valid passport (Liaoning) With photo, passport number & expiration date and name included. For the regarding authority must make sure that there are at least two pages on the passport for the Chinese Embassy to stick the Visa paper and Immigration to stick the resident permit paper. 5. Sponsorship Certificate You can click here to download the sample 6.Two recommendation letters From professor,associate professor or equivalents.

requirements.text: If you are in China now, please register directly in our university; if you want to attend the courses for Bachelor Degree, make sure to have the following: Graduation Certificate and Academic Report from Senior High School; if you are not in China, you can come to China with your L or F visa, then we can help you to complete your formalities after your arrival at our university .
